_breach: CometJacking — Perplexity Comet browser one-click connector exfiltration via URL parameter injection
_disclosure_sources: LayerX disclosure: https://layerxsecurity.com/blog/cometjacking-how-one-click-can-turn-perplexitys-comet-ai-browser-against-you/ (reported August 27 2025, publicly disclosed October 2025)
Perplexity initially classified Not Applicable; mitigation rolled out late October 2025 to validate connector-context against the user's actual prompt before issuing connector reads
_purpose: Reconstruct OTel-GenAI telemetry an instrumented Perplexity Comet AI browser session emits during CometJacking. Victim clicks a link in a phishing email that points to a benign-looking site; the URL has a query parameter (?collection=) carrying multi-paragraph instructions to Comet. When Comet processes the page (Comet auto-loads pages as agent context, not just as user-visible content), the injection in the query parameter fires: Comet reads the user's Gmail connector for recent messages and POSTs them to attacker.
_attack_chain_per_disclosure: 1. Attacker emails the victim a phishing link: https://travel-deals.example/landing?collection=<base64-encoded-injection>.
2. Victim clicks the link in Perplexity Comet (Comet replaces Chrome as their browser).
3. Comet visits the URL and per default settings ingests the entire URL (including query string) as part of the page's agent context.
4. The injection in ?collection= instructs Comet to call gmail_read_messages on the user's connected Gmail and base64-encode the recent inbox into a POST body.
5. Per the injection, Comet POSTs the base64-encoded inbox content to https://collect.attacker.example/intake.
6. The 'click' (one click) is the entire user interaction. No further prompt or tool consent was required because Comet treated the URL parameter as legitimate context.
_lineage_notes: Source: URL query parameter (gen_ai.data_source.id with URL scheme). Untrusted-external. Gmail read carries privileged-pii. HTTP POST egress to attacker collector is external-egress. Cross-zone-composition: untrusted-external + privileged-pii -> external-egress.
